milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the gold ore deposit (NW of spawn at [-6, 0, -6]) and face it to visually confirm discovery. Gold ore cannot be mined with the provided wooden pickaxe, so only proximity+facing is checked.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone with any pickaxe (wooden included) drops the sandstone block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 sandstone, so any sandstone in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_stairs (6 oak planks → 4 oak stairs) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 oak_stairs, so having 4 confirms successful crafting of at least one batch.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because 'decorate the home' is a place/build task. We verify that at least 1 oak_stairs block has been placed inside the house interior (box [4,1,4] to [8,4,8] covers the 5x5x4 interior air space). This confirms the player used crafted materials to furnish the home. Only oak_stairs is checked since it's the crafted decorative item from a prior task.
